Source: @jebheheslahat

❇️Mohsen Armin summoned to the Security Prosecutor's Office🔺Mohsen Armin, First Vice-President of the Iranian Reform Front, was summoned to the Security Prosecutor's Office of District 33 and was released on bail after interrogation.◾️This summoning is part of the ongoing process of summoning members of the Board of Directors of the Iranian Reform Front. The subject of the case relates to the statement by the Iranian Reform Front in reaction to the events of 18 and 19 Dey, which was published in Bahman.◾️After appearing at the prosecutor's office and answering the interrogator's questions, Mohsen Armin was released on bail.🔹The address of the Iranian Reform Front on social networks: Telegram, Instagram, X (Twitter)
